$description: SIRAJ Motion System v1.0 — AIR / WIND. Air is the force that moves everything soft in SIRAJ motion: the silk, and the trees and plants in and around the project. Nothing soft moves by itself, on a tween or on a loop; it moves because air passes through it. Client rule 2026-10-13. Shared by the Silk Motion Engine, the intro/outro, motion components and every generated or filmed video brief.

principle.ar: الهواء هو ما يحرّك الحرير والأشجار والنباتات. لا شيء ليّن يتحرك وحده؛ يتحرك لأن نسمةً مرّت به.
principle.en: Air moves the silk, the trees and the plants. Nothing soft moves on its own; it moves because a breeze passed through it.

direction.note: One prevailing direction per scene (right → left follows Arabic reading). Silk, leaves and fronds in the same shot all lean the same way; they never move against each other.

still.use: logo holds, end cards, reading time

whisper.use: default ambience: intro opening, backgrounds, loops

gust.use: one accent per film at most: the moment the veil lifts

behaviour.travelling_wave: A wave enters the silk on the windward edge and travels across it; the leeward edge follows 120–300 ms later (phase lag).
behaviour.gust_envelope: Gusts rise over 600–900 ms (ease 'flow'), hold ≤ 400 ms, and fall over 1200–1800 ms (ease 'drape'). Never a step, a snap or a bounce.
behaviour.turbulence: Low-frequency noise only (2–3 octaves, ≤ 0.6 Hz). No jitter, no high-frequency flutter, no flapping like a flag.
behaviour.settle: When the air drops, cloth and leaves SETTLE: a decaying sway of 1–2 cycles, no overshoot past the rest pose.
behaviour.foliage: Palms and trees sway from the trunk with the crown lagging; leaves flicker softly in the light. Small plants move before large trees and settle after them.
behaviour.light: Moving leaves and silk let light pass and break: dappled shadow drifting over stone is part of the wind, not a separate effect.
behaviour.sound: Optional soft air bed (low breeze, leaves) under the music; never a howling storm or whoosh effects.

never: storm, strong wind, flags snapping, debris, rain
silk moving with no visible air logic (rigid tween, looping wobble)
silk and foliage moving in opposite directions
bounce, elastic, shake or glitch caused by 'wind'
wind that bends or distorts the architecture — the building never moves
wrinkled, crinkled, crushed or creased (un-ironed) silk

video_prompt.en: a gentle evening breeze from right to left moves the smooth, freshly pressed maroon silk (no wrinkles or creases) in slow travelling waves; the palms and trees around the building sway softly in the same direction, leaves catching soft ivory-rose light (no yellow or golden cast); the architecture is perfectly still; calm, cinematic, no storm; close-ups rendered in 4K
video_prompt.ar: نسمة مسائية هادئة من اليمين إلى اليسار تحرّك الحرير العنابي الأملس المكويّ (بلا تجاعيد أو ثنيات) بموجاتٍ بطيئة تعبره؛ النخيل والأشجار حول المبنى تتمايل برفق في الاتجاه نفسه وأوراقها تلتقط ضوءاً عاجياً وردياً ناعماً (بلا اصفرار أو ذهبي)؛ العمارة ثابتة تماماً؛ هدوء سينمائي بلا عاصفة؛ اللقطات القريبة بدقة 4K

silk_finish.rule: Pressed silk only: smooth, liquid folds and a clean continuous sheen. Never wrinkled, crinkled, crushed or creased (un-ironed) silk (client rule 2026-10-13).
silk_finish.close_ups: Close-up shots use high-resolution footage: generate at the highest resolution available (4K, minimum 1080p, high bitrate). Never upscale a soft clip into a close-up.
